findings.summary: scripts/verify_integration.py verify_authorization and scripts/validate_evidence.py live reconciliation never compare the authorization PR/base/candidate tuple to the live pull request or current remote main. A self-consistent wrong tuple, including base_sha equal to candidate_sha, matching Gate Records/refs/comments, and a successful candidate CI run is accepted. Release therefore cannot rely on the validator to reject a wrong PR base, related-but-wrong candidate/base, or moved base as the frozen exact-authorization contract requires. Repair by fetching the claimed PR and remote main during mandatory live reconciliation, requiring exact PR number, open/unmerged state, head SHA, base SHA/ref, remote branch SHA, remote main SHA, candidate tree and ancestry/divergence, and add self-consistent wrong-tuple and moved-base regression tests.
